lines.en: label mikuinvite1:
I tap on Miku’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Miku 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: Now that things have calmed down for the time being, I feel that it’s finally safe for me to invite her over so we continue progressing our...{i}relationship{/i} in a much more private manner.
lines.zh: 既然眼下事情暂时平息了，我觉得终于可以安全地把她请过来，好让我们以一种更私密的方式继续推进我们的……{i}关系{/i}。

lines.en: if kirinlust30 == False:
Hopefully in a way that leads to me receiving some form of satisfaction this time as all I’ve really done thus far is finger her until she cries.
lines.zh: 希望这次能让我也得到某种满足，毕竟到目前为止我真正做过的，就只是用手指把她弄哭。

lines.en: else:
Hopefully in a way that leads to me receiving some form of {i}fully-conscious{/i} satisfaction this time. Or, at the bare minimum, something more exciting than fingering her until she cries again.
lines.zh: 希望这次能让我在{i}双方都清醒{/i}的状态下得到某种满足。或者退一万步说，来点比“用手指把她弄哭”更刺激的事。

lines.en: And while that’s cool and all, it would be nice to shake things up in a manner more intimate than letting her dry hump me in bed next to her friend.
lines.zh: 虽然那样也不错，不过要是能换个花样，来点比“让她在朋友旁边隔着衣服蹭我”更亲密的事，那就更好了。

lines.en: If she {i}wants{/i} to do that again, I’m not opposed. I should just probably get permission from Makoto first so I don’t have to go through another intervention.
lines.zh: 如果她{i}还想{/i}再来一次，我也不反对。只是我大概该先征得 Makoto 的同意，免得再来一次“干预”。

lines.en: : Hiyo, Sensei! What’cha up to?
lines.zh: : 嗨哟，Sensei！在干啥呢？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just letting my imagination run wild. You?
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是让我的想象力撒个野。你呢？

lines.en: : Just hangin’ with Makoto. Wanna say hi?
lines.zh: : 正跟 Makoto 待着呢。要跟她打个招呼吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Put her on for a second.
lines.zh: : 好。让她接一下。

lines.en: : Roger that! Please hold. {i}Makoto! Your boyfriend wants to talk!{/i}
lines.zh: : 收到！请稍等。{i}Makoto！你男朋友想跟你说话！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}To me? Really? Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}找我？真的？为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Maybe to confess his undying love? Come find out!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}也许是来表白他至死不渝的爱？快来听听！{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...hello?
: Hey. I was just wondering if I could have permission to bone your roommate.
lines.zh: : 嘿。我就是想问问，能不能允许我干你的室友。

lines.en: : {i}Here, Miku. You can have the phone back.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}给，Miku。电话还你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Huh? Already? That was quick.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈？这么快？也太快了吧。{/i}

lines.en: : Sensei? Makoto looks friggin’ pissed. What did you say to her?
lines.zh: : Sensei？Makoto 看起来气得要命。你跟她说了什么？

lines.en: : Just something that needed to be said. Don’t worry about it. Anyway, do you want to come over?
lines.zh: : 只是些非说不可的话。别管了。对了，你要过来吗？

lines.en: : Sure! When?
lines.zh: : 好啊！什么时候？

lines.en: : Now.
lines.zh: : 现在。

lines.en: : Like...{i}now{/i} now?
lines.zh: : 你……说{i}现在{/i}就现在？

lines.en: : Does that work for you?
lines.zh: : 你方便吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I’ve gotta bring Makoto. We had plans and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我得带上 Makoto。我们本来有安排的。

lines.en: : Gotcha. Can you put her on again?
lines.zh: : 明白。能再让她接一下吗？

lines.en: : {i}Makoto! Round two!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Makoto！第二轮！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ugh! What now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呃！又怎么了？{/i}

lines.en: : Hello?
: How do you feel about threesomes?
lines.zh: : 你对三人行有什么看法？

lines.en: if makotofutabafuntimelustevent == False:
: Aren’t you supposed to be nicer to me? Isn’t that a thing we talked about?
lines.zh: : 你不是该对我好一点吗？我们不是说过这个吗？

lines.en: : How do you feel about threesomes...{i}please?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你对三人行有什么看法……{i}拜托？{/i}

lines.en: else:
: Are you seriously asking me that right now? Have you not already done enough?
lines.zh: : 你现在是认真的吗？你做的还不够多吗？

lines.en: : I just want to know more about you.
lines.zh: : 我只是想多了解你一些。

lines.en: : I think you know more than enough by now, thank you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你现在知道的已经够多了，谢谢。

lines.en: : It would sure be swell if you were into them as much as I am.
lines.zh: : 要是你能像我一样喜欢这回事，那可就太好了。

lines.en: : {i}Take it back. I can’t handle this today.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}把这话收回去。我今天受不了这个。{/i}

lines.en: : Jeez, Sensei. You’re really strikin’ out today, aren’t ya?
lines.zh: : 天哪，Sensei。你今天真是屡战屡败啊？

lines.en: : It unfortunately appears that way. I’ll get her to come around, though.
lines.zh: : 可惜看起来是这样。不过我会让她想通的。

lines.en: : Oh she’s come plenty of rounds if you know what I’m sayin’.
lines.zh: : 哦，她可“来”过不少次了，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : Get it? Cause you give her orgasms and stuff.
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？因为你会让她高潮什么的。

lines.en: : Have I unlocked a new side of you?
lines.zh: : 我是不是解锁了你新的一面？

lines.en: : Probably! I’ll start gettin’ ready and the two of us’ll drop by your house in like...an hour? That work?
lines.zh: : 也许是吧！我开始准备了，我们俩大概……一个小时以后到你家？行吗？

lines.en: : Sure. I hope Makoto is prepared. She seems a little confrontational today.
lines.zh: : 行。希望 Makoto 做好准备。她今天看起来有点好斗。

lines.en: : {i}Go to Hell! I can hear you!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}去死吧！我听得见！{/i}

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？

lines.en: : Hahah! I’m sure she’ll be fine once we get there. But I’m gonna go shower and stuff, so...bye! See you soon!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！等我们到了她就没事了。不过我要去洗澡什么的了，所以……拜！回头见！

lines.en: scene black
Miku hangs up the phone and...
lines.zh: Miku 挂了电话，然后……

lines.en: And I am left on my own to prepare for a threesome that will almost definitely not happen.
lines.zh: 于是只剩下我一个人，为一场几乎肯定不会发生的三人行做准备。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv1
: Heeeey. Haven’t been here in a hot minute.
lines.zh: : 嘿————。好久没来这儿了。

lines.en: : You still lettin’ girls sneak into your room to ride your junk while you’re asleep?
lines.zh: : 你还在让女孩子趁你睡着溜进你房间骑你的老二吗？

lines.en: : On occasion. Interesting choice of ice breaker, Miku.
lines.zh: : 偶尔吧。这开场白选得挺有意思，Miku。

lines.en: : Yeah...I ain’t really used to this whole “boy house” thing after my sexual awakening. Not gonna lie. Feels kinda lewd.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我性觉醒之后，还真不太习惯这种“男生的房子”。说实话，感觉有点淫靡。

lines.en: : I hate you.
lines.zh: : 我恨你。

lines.en: : So that’s a no to the threesome, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以三人行是不行了，对吧？

lines.en: : I hate you a lot.
lines.zh: : 我非常恨你。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv2
: What’s this about a threesome?
lines.zh: : 三人行是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Miku. Don’t.
lines.zh: : Miku。别问。

lines.en: : I mean, I guess if I’m gonna have one, doin’ it with you would probably be best. I still don’t really know what I’m doin’, though. Ya might have to show me the ropes.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果我要搞一次三人行，那跟你一起大概是最好的。不过我还不太清楚该怎么做。你可能得教教我。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv3
: Look at what you’ve done to my sweet, innocent friend! She’s turning into my mom and I would literally die if I suddenly had two of them!
lines.zh: : 看看你把我那个甜美又单纯的朋友弄成什么样了！她正在变成我妈，要是我突然有了两个妈，我真的会死！

lines.en: : There goes my secret dream of her ending up with Haruka.
lines.zh: 我那“让她最后跟 Haruka 在一起”的隐秘梦想就这么泡汤了。

lines.en: : Besides, I doubt it was {i}me{/i} who did this to her. This side of Miku has probably been buried deep down her entire life. Right, Miku?
lines.zh: : 再说，我怀疑把她变成这样的不是{i}我{/i}。Miku 的这一面大概从她出生起就一直深埋在底下。对吧，Miku？

lines.en: : Hm? Oh, no. This is your fault. I have seen the light.
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦，不。这是你的错。我已经看见了光。

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei！

lines.en: : I did not mean for this to happen...but I am glad it did.
lines.zh: : 我不是故意要变成这样的……不过我很高兴变成了这样。

lines.en: : Yeah, until she starts running her mouth about it to everyone else!
lines.zh: : 是吗，等她开始到处跟别人乱说，你就高兴不起来了！

lines.en: : You know Miku’s attention span is...inadequate! It’s only a matter of time until she forgets this is something that’s meant to be kept {i}secret!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道 Miku 的注意力持续时间……很成问题！她迟早会忘了这件事是需要{i}保密{/i}的！

lines.en: : That’s fair. Ami could have been home and listening in on this entire conversation. You’re lucky she’s not.
lines.zh: : 这倒是。Ami 本来可能在家，把整段对话都听去了。算你们走运，她不在。

lines.en: : If Ami was home, she woulda popped out of her room the second I talked about ridin’ your junk.
lines.zh: : 要是 Ami 在家，我一说到骑你的老二，她就会从房间里蹦出来。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv4
: Also, you guys ain’t givin’ me enough credit! I ain’t gonna go around blabbin’ about this to everybody! I‘m too young to die!
lines.zh: : 还有，你们太小看我了！我才不会到处跟人瞎说这个！我还年轻，还不想死！

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : Listen, I get that you’re excited to be, umm...{i}learning about your body-{/i}
lines.zh: : 听着，我理解你很兴奋，呃……在{i}探索自己的身体{/i}——

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv5
: Oh, come on! Please don’t go into teacher mode in front of my friend-with-benefits. You’re gonna take all the benefits away.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托！别在我的炮友面前切换成老师模式。你会把那点好处全弄没的。

lines.en: : ...but, you need to be careful. This man is relentless. He will use you and cast you aside for someone else before you even know it.
lines.zh: : ……不过，你得小心。这个男人是不会罢休的。他会在你还没反应过来之前就把你用完，然后为了别人把你丢到一边。

lines.en: : Hi. Still here.
lines.zh: : 嗨。我还在这儿呢。

lines.en: : Ain’t that a little hyper-critical?
lines.zh: : 这是不是有点太吹毛求疵了？

lines.en: : A little...{i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 有点……{i}什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv6
: Uhh...
: Hippo...criminal?
lines.zh: : 河马……罪犯？

lines.en: : No...I’m pretty sure “critical” is in there somewhere and...
lines.zh: : 不……我很确定里面有“critical”这个词，而且……

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv7
: A-hah! It’s hippie-critical, ain’t it?! Cause they were always sayin’ stuff that didn’t make much sense! See! I ain’t dumb!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！是嬉皮批判对吧？！因为他们老说些没道理的话！看吧！我可不傻！

lines.en: : Is this really a creature you think you should be making sexual contact with?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得该跟这种生物发生性接触吗？

lines.en: : I may be currently rethinking my decision. That much I will admit.
lines.zh: : 我现在可能正在重新考虑我的决定。这一点我承认。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv8
: {i}Regardless,{/i} the reason I accompanied Miku here instead of letting her run off alone was precisely so something like that would {i}not{/i} happen.
lines.zh: : {i}无论如何，{/i}我之所以陪 Miku 一起来、而不是让她一个人跑来，正是为了{i}不让{/i}那种事发生。

lines.en: : So, in other words, you were jealous.
lines.zh: : 换句话说，你是吃醋了。

lines.en: : That...may have played some role as well, I will admit.
lines.zh: : 那……可能也起了点作用，我承认。

lines.en: : But the gist is that nothing like that will be happening today because we are {i}both{/i} here and singling out {i}one{/i} of us for...things...would be unfair.
lines.zh: : 但重点是，今天不会有那种事，因为我们{i}两个{/i}都在，而单独挑出我们其中{i}一个{/i}来做……那种事……是不公平的。

lines.en: : So if I wanted to single out {i}you{/i} instead...
lines.zh: : 那要是我偏偏想单独挑{i}你{/i}呢……

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv9
: Obviously, Miku would never agree to such-
lines.zh: : 显然，Miku 是绝对不会同意这种——

lines.en: : I can wait out here. Feels like you need it more than me. Knock ‘im dead, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我可以在外面等。感觉你比我更需要。拿下他，Makoto。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv10
: I...suppose letting you get it out of your system may be of {i}some{/i} benefit to us.
lines.zh: : 我……想，让你发泄一下，对我们也许{i}有点{/i}好处。

lines.en: : I’m telling ya, Sensei. You’ve got a magic wiener. It’s the only explanation.
lines.zh: : 我跟你说，Sensei。你有一根魔法小兄弟。这是唯一的解释。

lines.en: : Listen, we don’t {i}need{/i} to do anything like that today if it will exclude one of you. I called Miku because I wanted to invite her over. Making her wait out here would be flat out rude.
lines.zh: : 听着，如果那样做会排除你们其中一个，那我们今天就{i}不必{/i}做了。我打电话给 Miku，是因为想请她过来。让她在外面等着，那也太失礼了。

lines.en: : As if being rude was ever an actual concern of yours...
lines.zh: : 说得好像你真的在乎失不失礼似的……

lines.en: : If we ain’t gonna bump uglies, whaddya wanna do instead? Jump on Ami’s bed? Microwave stuff we ain’t supposed to microwave? Oooh, you got any games we could play?
lines.zh: : 既然不做那档子事，那你想干点什么？在 Ami 的床上蹦？把不该微波的东西丢进微波炉？哦哦，你有没有什么游戏可以玩？

lines.en: : I have the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon.
lines.zh: : 我有 1999 年的 PC 经典，《过山车大亨》。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv11
: I {i}love{/i} the 1999 PC classic, Rollercoaster Tycoon!
lines.zh: : 我{i}超爱{/i} 1999 年的 PC 经典《过山车大亨》！

lines.en: : Why are you guys saying it like that?
lines.zh: : 你们为什么要那么说？

lines.en: : Where’d you get a copy? That’s a piece of vintage memorabilia, ya know.
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿弄到的？那可是件复古的纪念品，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Io found the time to drop it off between pretending to be a pharmacist and slinging you pills.
lines.zh: : Io 在假扮药剂师和给你倒药之间，还抽空把它送过来了。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv12
: Between {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 在{i}什么{/i}之间？

lines.en: : {i}Shh!{/i}
scene mikumakotoinv13
: Miku, what-
lines.zh: : Miku，什么——

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei! That’s a funny joke you just made! Anyway, time to go into your room and see what kind of stuff you’re hiding from us!
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei！你刚才那个笑话真好笑！总之，该进你房间看看你都藏了些什么不让我们看的东西了！

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv14
: It’s this one, right? Hope you don’t mind me looking through your stuff!
lines.zh: : 是这扇门吧？希望你不介意我翻翻你的东西！

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv15
: I’m sorry, I think I misheard you. Something about...pills? And...Io pretending to be a pharmacist?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我想我是听错了。什么……药？还有……Io 假扮药剂师？

lines.en: : Sensei, if you know something-
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果你知道什么——

lines.en: : It was just a tasteless joke. It didn’t actually mean anything.
lines.zh: : 那只是个没分寸的玩笑。其实没有任何含义。

lines.en: : That just seems like such a random and uncalled for-
lines.zh: : 那听起来也太突然、太没来由了——

lines.en: scene black
: Come on. Let’s go make sure Miku doesn’t find my secret porn stash and unlock an even dirtier section of her brain.
lines.zh: : 走吧。我们去确保 Miku 别找到我藏的片库，别又给她脑子里解锁一块更脏的区域。

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: I wanted to tell Makoto.
lines.zh: 我本来想告诉 Makoto 的。

lines.en: And in hindsight, I probably should have.
lines.zh: 现在回想，我大概本该说出口。

lines.en: But sometimes the “right” thing to do isn’t as easy as the other options.
lines.zh: 但有时候，“正确”的那件事，做起来并不像其他选项那么容易。

lines.en: And sometimes, in order to save someone, you must sacrifice something else.
lines.zh: 而有时候，想要救一个人，就必须牺牲另一样东西。

lines.en: if kirinlust30 == True:
Not only would giving away Miku’s newest secret put our new {i}relationship{/i} in jeopardy, but it could potentially expose {i}me{/i} as well.
lines.zh: 把 Miku 最新的秘密说出去，不仅会让我们这段新{i}关系{/i}陷入危险，也可能把{i}我自己{/i}也暴露出来。

lines.en: She’s not the only one who’s hiding something. And by all means, what I’m hiding is a lot more sinister.
lines.zh: 她不是唯一一个藏着东西的人。而且无论怎么看，我藏着的那个都要阴暗得多。

lines.en: Besides, it’s quite possible she doesn’t need saving in the first place.
lines.zh: 再说，很可能她根本就不需要被拯救。

lines.en: It’s quite possible that whatever Io is doing will work for Miku...and that there’s no real risk involved at all.
lines.zh: 很可能 Io 在做的事对 Miku 有效……而且根本没什么真正的风险。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: If that were the case, Makoto would know.
lines.zh: 如果是那样，Makoto 就会知道。

lines.en: And the fact that she doesn’t tells me Miku’s hiding it from her on purpose.
lines.zh: 而她不知道这个事实告诉我，Miku 是故意瞒着她的。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv16
At what point is it okay to begin distributing information that doesn’t belong to you? And how can you package it up to make it seem like you’re doing it with good intentions?
lines.zh: 从什么时候开始，散布不属于你的信息就变成可以接受的了？你又要怎么包装它，才能让它看起来像是出于善意？

lines.en: In all actuality, it’s not about wanting to save anyone at all. It’s about wanting to maintain the status quo — where everything is peaceful and you can stick your dick inside of as many teenagers as you want.
lines.zh: 实际上，这根本不是想救谁的问题。这是想维持现状的问题——一切都风平浪静，你可以把你的鸡巴塞进任意多个少女的身体里。

lines.en: The disruption of that pattern would shake my world to the core when my world was built upon that principle.
lines.zh: 一旦这个模式被打断，我的世界就会从根基上动摇，因为我的世界正是建立在那个原则之上的。

lines.en: It is not my place to put Miku in hers, and it is not Makoto’s place to raze both of them in an endless pursuit of what is right.
lines.zh: 我没有立场把 Miku 推进她自己的世界，Makoto 也没有立场为了无休止地追求“正确”而把两个世界都夷为平地。

lines.en: The three of us will stay like this so we may one day stay as something else.
lines.zh: 我们三个会就这样维持下去，好让我们有朝一日能变成别的什么。

lines.en: Something close to what the real me wants.
lines.zh: 某种接近真正的我所想要的东西。

lines.en: Not whoever I’m becoming.
lines.zh: 而不是我正在变成的那个东西。

lines.en: : Sensei, why the heck do you even own Mario Kart if you’re so friggin’ bad at it?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你玩得这么烂，到底为什么要买《马力欧卡丁车》啊？

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize I had this.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道自己有这个。

lines.en: : I fucking hate Waluigi. Get out of my way, you piece of shit. I hope the fishing line snaps the next time they reel you up. Asshole.
lines.zh: : 我他妈的恨死瓦路易吉了。给我滚开，你这该死的混蛋。希望下次有人把你钓上来的时候鱼线会断。混账东西。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv17
: Need some help figurin’ out the controls? I’ve heard it can be pretty tough for people your age to just start playin’ games this late in life.
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙搞清楚操作吗？我听说像你这个年纪的人，这么晚才开始玩游戏会挺吃力的。

lines.en: : I’m only 31, Miku. I’m still well below the median age in the country.
lines.zh: : 我才 31 岁，Miku。在国内还远低于平均年龄呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, but Japan’s got a bazillion old people. You’re still kinda prehistoric by our standards, ya know.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可日本有一大堆老年人。按我们的标准，你已经有点史前生物了，你知道吗。

lines.en: : Even if half the class is apparently into that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 尽管半个班的人好像就好这口。

lines.en: : It isn’t half the class. It’s the entire class. Everyone is fighting for Sensei’s affection- even the ones who deny it.
lines.zh: : 不是半个班，是整个班。每个人都在争夺 Sensei 的宠爱——连那些嘴上否认的也是。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv18
: WALUIGI, YOU LANKY CUCK! I WILL FUCKING MURDER YOU!
lines.zh: : 瓦路易吉，你这瘦长的绿帽男！我他妈的要杀了你！

lines.en: : I’ll be fine figuring out the controls. Just promise not to laugh at me when I come in last place.
lines.zh: : 操作我自己能搞明白。只要你答应，我拿最后一名的时候别笑话我。

lines.en: : I ain’t gonna laugh at ya, Sensei. It’s still just a game at the end of the day and havin’ fun will always be the most important thing.
lines.zh: : 我不会笑你的，Sensei。说到底这只是个游戏，玩得开心永远是最重要的。

lines.en: : FUCK! YOU!
lines.zh: : 操！你！

lines.en: : Even if we’ve got people like Makoto who have trouble turning the competitive part of their brain off.
lines.zh: : 就算有 Makoto 这样的人，脑子里的好胜心总是关不掉。

lines.en: : You’d think Kumon-mi High’s greatest athlete would be the {i}more{/i} competitive one, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你会以为 Kumon-mi 高中最厉害的运动员才是{i}更{/i}好胜的那个吧？

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv19
: I ain’t that special. 'Specially now that soccer’s gone.
lines.zh: : 我没那么特别。尤其是现在足球已经没了。

lines.en: : Swimming’s fun, I guess. Just doesn’t feel the same, though. Ain’t no crazy adrenaline rush that comes from a breakaway or anythin’ like that.
lines.zh: : 游泳是挺好玩的，我猜。不过感觉不一样。单刀突破那种肾上腺素狂飙的感觉，是游泳给不了的。

lines.en: : It...could come back one day. Right?
lines.zh: : 它……有朝一日会回来的。对吧？

lines.en: : Soccer? Doubt it. We ain’t got the numbers for it and there ain’t any reason to form the team back up without anybody to play.
lines.zh: : 足球？我看悬。我们人数不够，而且没人可打，也没理由把队伍重新组起来。

lines.en: : It’s fine, though. Just gives me more time to focus on other things.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。这样我倒有更多时间专注在别的事上了。

lines.en: : Other things...like what?
lines.zh: : 别的事……比如什么？

lines.en: : I wonder.
lines.zh: : 你说呢。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv20
: Hey. What do you think you’re doing? Public displays of affection are rude even {i}if{/i} you’re only displaying said affection in front of your best friend.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你这是要干什么？当众秀恩爱可是很失礼的，{i}哪怕{/i}你只是在你最好的朋友面前秀。

lines.en: : Guess I’m rude, then. Cause I ain’t got any intention of movin’ any time soon.
lines.zh: : 那我就是个失礼的人吧。因为我一时半会儿可没打算挪开。

lines.en: : You know he’s got a second shoulder open, don’t ya? Why don’t you rest your head a little too?
lines.zh: : 你知道他还有另一边肩膀空着吧？你要不要把头也靠上来？

lines.en: : Ain’t a threesome like Sensei wanted but it still lets all of us be close together.
lines.zh: : 虽然不是 Sensei 想要的那种三人行，不过这样我们三个也照样能靠在一起。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv21
: You’re going to lose the race with that sort of mindset, Miku.
lines.zh: : 抱着那种心态，你会输掉比赛的，Miku。

lines.en: : You sure it ain’t you who’s gonna run out of gas first? Always keepin’ the pedal to the metal and whatnot. Just stay steady and keep your eyes on the prize, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你确定先没油的不是你吗？老是油门踩到底什么的。稳住，眼睛盯着终点就行，Makoto。

lines.en: : Nice try, but there is no gas in Mario Kart.
lines.zh: : 想得美，可《马力欧卡丁车》里没有油这种东西。

lines.en: : Who says I’m still talkin’ about Mario Kart?
lines.zh: : 谁说我现在还在聊《马力欧卡丁车》了？

lines.en: : What are those boxes? Do they slow you down if you hit them?
lines.zh: : 那些箱子是什么？撞到了会减速吗？

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv22
: They’ve got power-ups and stuff inside. You smash ‘em and use whatever you get to mess with the other people on the track.
lines.zh: : 里面装着道具什么的。你撞开它们，拿到什么就用什么去整赛道上的其他人。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 原来如此……

lines.en: : Do ya? Cause it seems to me like you’re just starin’ at Makoto now.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？因为在我看来，你现在只是在盯着 Makoto 看。

lines.en: : That’s a new dress, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那是条新裙子，对吧？

lines.en: : Took you long enough.
lines.zh: : 你总算注意到了。

lines.en: : It looks great. You’re beautiful.
lines.zh: : 很好看。你很美。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv23
: Wha- huh?! Me?! You...really think so?!
lines.zh: : 什——哈？！我？！你……真的这么觉得？！

lines.en: : I got a little jealous that Miku had one and I didn’t so-
lines.zh: : 我有点嫉妒 Miku 有一条而我没有，所以——

lines.en: : That was Makoto I just hit, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我刚才撞到的是 Makoto 吧？

lines.en: : Yuuuup. Great strategy, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是啊是啊。好策略啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Takin’ somebody out IRL so you can hit ‘em in-game is a real power move.
lines.zh: : 现实里先搞定一个人，再在游戏里撞她，这可真是高招。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv24
: You...fucking asshole! You distracted me! I’ll get you back for this!
lines.zh: : 你……你这个混蛋！你害我分心了！这事我跟你没完！

lines.en: : Not if I have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: : 只要我还有办法，就不会让你得逞。

lines.en: scene mikumakotoinv25
: Wha- you too?! {i}Both{/i} of you are ganging up on me now?! What did I do to deserve this?!
lines.zh: : 什——你也？！你们{i}两个{/i}现在联合起来对付我了？！我到底做了什么要遭这种报应？！

lines.en: : Drive, Sensei! Drive! Show us how much all those years of wisdom are really worth!
lines.zh: : 开车，Sensei！快开！让我们看看你这么多年的智慧到底值多少钱！

lines.en: : I think I just fell off.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我刚掉下去了。

lines.en: : Baby steps, Sensei. Baby steps.
lines.zh: : 一步一步来，Sensei。一步一步来。

lines.en: scene black
The three of us sit in my room playing the same game for the next two hours.
lines.zh: 接下来的两个小时，我们三个坐在我的房间里玩同一个游戏。

lines.en: Makoto eventually falls asleep on my arm, prompting Miku to take it upon herself to talk more about how “cute” the two of us look together.
lines.zh: Makoto 最后靠在我的手臂上睡着了，于是 Miku 主动肩负起责任，开始不停地说我们两个看起来有多“般配”。

lines.en: It’s strange to me how she can still say something like that with a smile on her face.
lines.zh: 我总觉得奇怪，她怎么还能带着笑容说出那种话。

lines.en: I find it cute how genuine the love she has for her best friend is. And while something like that {i}should{/i} feel ideal for me as Miku doesn’t intend to pose any sort of threat...
lines.zh: 她对她最好的朋友那份爱有多真诚，我觉得很可爱。而按理说，既然 Miku 并不打算对我构成任何威胁，这对我来说{i}应该是{/i}最理想的状态……

lines.en: All I can think of is that I really wish she would.
lines.zh: 可我满脑子想的都是：我真希望她会。

lines.en: And that she’d look better in my eyes if she would just pull me a little closer to her.
lines.zh: 而如果她能把我再拉近一点，她在我眼里就会更好看。

$ miku_love += 1
$ makoto_love += 1
